integrity.mathematical_basis: Exact Schur-complement formulas and rational sign identities over all admissible real parameters; finite exact matrix checks are supplementary.
integrity.reproducibility: verify.py is a standalone Python 3 exact-rational checker using only the standard library.

scientific_limitations: Exactly two noise-free leaders, m>=4 leaves, and constant conductances within each hub-to-leaf edge family.
No claim for directed networks, noisy leaders, independently heterogeneous spokes or other leader budgets.
Full originality cannot be independently certified from indexed literature; an equivalent unindexed result might exist.
title: A sharp two-leader transition surface for weighted triangular-book networks
